notes.title: Early Access - Update #04
notes.notes:
The tuning menu still needs some time, but since I forgot to disable the physics change on snow in the last update, here's a small fix:
I added a menu to the mechanic to change tires for snow (currently offroad is best for snow).
The cost depends on the vehicle price and the number of wheels ^^

I'm currently working on re-adjusting the vehicles, because after some changes, not all of them drive as they should...

notes.title: Demo Update v1.1
notes.notes:
Thanks to Master Kyodais Feedback, here´s the first update:

[h2]ADDED[/h2]
- Added the players money to the Vehicle Shop widget
- Added sounds for repair, buying vehicle, refuel and finishing delivery
- Added a function to check if the character is falling without the ground below and teleport back to the ground
- Added functionality to allow driving backwards in airplanes
- Tab Menu (map) can get closed now with tab

[h2]CHANGED[/h2]
- Increased profit for all cargo types by 100-200% (pallets and lifestock more than packages)
- Vehicles in the shop are now removed correctly when it was bought
- Changed the color of the players money in vehicle shop, gas station and repair widgets to green, like in the HUD
- Changed overlap cylinders to be visible only when in a vehicle
- Changed default antialiasing method to TAA from TSR which has a much better performance, but some issues with translucent materials

[h2]WHAT´S NEXT?[/h2]
- You can change the antialiasing method in the settings menu
- Overlap capsules will get changed to decals projected to the ground
